'''Marren Elna''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] who lived on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. She had a small shop in the [[Senate Commercial District]], where she sold synthetic fabrics and other materials for synthweaving.
